entries.title: I Samuel 22:1
segments: Adullam; in the tribe of Judah.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:3
segments:
Mizpeh; in Moab, on the east of Jordan. 
 
The distresses of children occasion great anxiety to parents, and right-minded children will strive to alleviate their sorrows, and as far as Providence may permit, to provide for their wants.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:5
segments:
Hareth; in the land of Judah. 
 
While we exercise our own best judgment, we should feel our need of divine guidance, seek wisdom from above, and be ready to go wherever God calls.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:6
segments: In Ramah; or, in a high place.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:7
segments: Men are apt to judge others by themselves, and when they are supremely selfish to think that others are so too.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:9
segments: I saw the son of Jesse;
To exalt themselves, and gain the favor of those above them, many will occasion the ruin of others, and even imbrue their hands in the blood of the innocent.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:11
segments: His father's house; the descendants of Eli.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:13
segments: Hast inquired of God for him; that is, as Saul alleges, with a view to aid him in his plan to possess himself of the kingdom.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:17
segments: Tyrants who resolve to take the life of their fellow men will not be hindered by want of reasons, or be backward to contend that the public good requires it.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:18
segments: Fourscore and five; thus was fulfilled the Lord's declaration to Eli,

. 
 
Rulers who require men to commit sin, will generally find some who are wicked enough to obey them.

entries.title: I Samuel 22:22
segments: To have been even the innocent occasion of the death of others is exceedingly distressing to an ingenuous mind, and much more distressing is it when it has been occasioned by their kindness to us or by our sins.
